assumptions.claim: External logic must drive all declared signals (op, mode, cipher_op, prng_reseed_rate, lc_escalate_en, data_in_prev_sel, state_in_sel, add_state_in_sel, add_state_out_sel, key_init_sel, iv_sel) to valid enumeration values before they are first read downstream.
assumptions.cond: Always, before any consumer reads these signals.
assumptions.risk: If unassigned or left at X, downstream logic may propagate metastable or illegal values; lc_escalate_en could trigger false life‑cycle escalation.

uncertain_points.claim: None of the declared signals receive a reset value or initial assignment in this region; downstream logic may read an undefined value if the signals are assigned too late or if a reset path is incomplete.
uncertain_points.cond: During simulation or in silicon after power-up, before the driving logic writes a valid value.
uncertain_points.risk: Uninitialized lc_escalate_en could cause unintended security escalation; other select signals may cause functional misbehavior or X‑optimization mismatches.
